reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getRangeAmount and getExpectedAmount, which every consumer (including getScheduledAmount) already calls.

duplication.why: Nothing is duplicated; both branches of the rule are simplified in their single definitions.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the layer that owns expected-amount logic.

scope.why: Only the two rule functions, their tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clean and minimal, but call-site comments in forecast-schedules.ts and schedules/app.ts still describe the old 'end furthest from zero' rule.
